audience: e-commerce and logistics teams that track parcels with Sorted Track

useCases.title: Find shipments by date or reference
useCases.text: Search shipments in a date window, or by tracking or custom reference. Open one to read its state.

useCases.title: Read the history of a shipment
useCases.text: List all tracking events of one shipment, and its state history with the time each state was set.

useCases.title: Read raw carrier events
useCases.text: Get the raw tracking events that the carrier sent for one shipment.

useCases.title: Register new shipments
useCases.text: Register one or more shipments with their tracking references. Search first, because a second registration creates a duplicate.

useCases.title: Correct a registered shipment
useCases.text: Update a registered shipment. Send the full shipment record, because the update uses the same fields as registration.
